title: Sadako Sasaki
note: Hiroshima atomic bomb survivor exposed at age two who contracted radiation-induced acute malignant lymph gland leukemia at eleven and folded one thousand origami cranes, becoming a global symbol of child victims of nuclear war.

title: Nihon Hidankyo (Japan Confederation of A- and H-Bomb Sufferers Organizations)
note: Grassroots confederation founded in 1956 by hibakusha across Japan to demand government compensation for bombing damages and advocate for the total abolition of nuclear weapons worldwide, awarded the 2024 Nobel Peace Prize.

title: Association of Korean Atomic Bomb Victims
note: Advocacy organization representing the estimated tens of thousands of Korean survivors of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, seeking medical relief, state compensation, and historical recognition for colonized and forced laborers exposed to the blasts.

title: Castle Bravo Nuclear Test and the Daigo Fukuryu Maru Incident
note: United States thermonuclear detonation at Bikini Atoll whose 15-megaton yield heavily irradiated Marshallese islanders on Rongelap and Utirik and the Japanese fishing vessel Lucky Dragon No. 5, catalyzing international anti-nuclear mobilization.
